title: Trawl Alert Investigation
description: Pivot from a detection to the records describing the same flow. Exact and approximate matches are shown separately and must not be read as equivalent.

options.content:
**Exact match** means both analyzers computed the same Community ID from the same packets. It is evidence that these records describe one flow.

**Approximate match** means the endpoints, protocol and time align but no Community ID was available. It can include a different connection that reused the same tuple inside the window. Do not treat an approximate match as confirmation.

panels.title: Detections
panels.description: Signature detections in range. Start a pivot by copying a Community ID from a record.

panels.title: EXACT match — same Community ID
panels.description: Every record sharing this Community ID. Both analyzers derived it independently from the same packets, so this is a confirmed pairing.

panels.title: APPROXIMATE match — endpoints and time only

targets.expr: {service_name="trawl-observation", cluster="$cluster"} | protocol = "$protocol" | (source_ip = "$source_ip" and destination_ip = "$destination_ip") or (source_ip = "$destination_ip" and destination_ip = "$source_ip")

panels.description: Records matching by endpoint pair and protocol, in either direction. No Community ID confirmed these. A different connection reusing the same tuple within the window will appear here.
